name: LumoAuth Guard
description: Checks every tool call before it runs: allowed, sent to you for approval, or blocked, with the policy held in LumoAuth. Protects its own key, OpenClaw's configuration and your credential stores whatever the policy says.

cliCommands.name: lumoauth
cliCommands.description: LumoAuth Guard: set up, check and lock the checks on every tool call
